MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.

2. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.

3. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

4. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.

5. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
6. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
